answer: Fake identities cost real capital, since low-tier accounts on the frozen tundra of zero history earn nothing until organic vouches thaw their standing. Sybil resistance via a staked identity terrace: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation tier, and every peer attestation is published to a public mirror ledger that anyone can audit. Forging N identities costs N bonds plus sustained attestation work, making mass impersonation economically irrational. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
